name: "The Homesick Lone Wolf"
desc: A lone wolf estranged from the local pack, with its teal mane indicating a bloodline from a faraway land. Perhaps it is the echo of its ancestors that still lingers in its veins, for it remains steadfast in guarding a sword cemetery long forgotten by the world. In the moonlight, it waits endlessly for a knight who will never find their way home.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Objective</color>
<color=#ffffff>Reward</color>
Defeat Local Legend: "The Homesick Lone Wolf."

customize.name: Primogem
customize.desc: A primordial crystalline gem that's beyond the mundane world. Shines with the condensed hopes and dreams of universes that once were.

customize.name: Radiant Exoskeleton
customize.desc:
A giant piece of bone that glows coldly, taken from the exterior of a glowing beast.
These beasts blessed by the ancient power of the moon are able to manipulate their exoskeletons through the light that has soaked into their marrow over long years. Even though their bones float apart from their bodies, they can still command them at will like any other physical part.

customize.name: Boreal Wolf's Cracked Tooth
customize.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The life of a wolf is not without violence; broken bones or cracked teeth are nothing special.
Andrius found humans to be a disappointment, but believed babies to be innocent. If both the wolf pack and the adopted children chose each other, then they become a Lupical, a fated family.

value.name: Radiant Glacial Wolf
value.desc:
A beast that has undergone a unique evolution due to age-long immersion in the ancient moon's power.
Legend has it that when a dark calamity wiped out countless lives, the frontier forests fell completely silent. In that stillness, the only sound to break the dead quiet was the howl of the Glacial Wolves calling to the moon. Night after night, their mournful cries echoed across the empty wilderness in the cold moonlight.

dropMaterial.name: Lightless Bone
dropMaterial.desc:
A dull piece of bone taken from the exterior of a glowing beast.
It is a fragment from the exoskeleton of a monster infused with the ancient power of the moon. Along with the vanished light, it has also lost the secrets once hidden within.

dropMaterial.name: Glowing Remains
dropMaterial.desc:
A faintly glowing piece of bone taken from the exterior of a glowing beast.
It is the remains of an exoskeleton in which a vestige of the ancient power of the moon still lingers. It emanates a deep hue that still lingers long after being separated from its body, steeped as it is in the power of the moon.
